scope: SOURCE ONLY. GT-derived augmentation; not an actual deployment initializer or human semantic evidence.

bank.normalizer: max(ptp(reference8,axis=0)); all8 original references, no per-slot filtering
bank.invalid_policy: Keep all768 rows. If nonfinite reference or nonpositive/nonfinite span, delta8 allNaN; if individual q nonfinite, preserve nonfinite delta. Report and retain mapped public rows; JSON nonfinite is null. No bank substitution.

mapping.native_slot_correlation: One complete8x2 bank vector per target; never independent slot draws

public_rows.source_order: Existing YCB instances.jsonl order, exact corpus[1003:] id join
public_rows.split: Original scenes0..7 TRAIN3400,8..9 VAL800 unchanged. Both use synthetic TRAIN-only error bank.
public_rows.filter: None: no teacher, class, mask, matched, quality, current or crop-visibility filtering

input_geometry.L: Exact native_grid(initial_points,raw_hw)[2]: clip(.25*maxptp(finite non-(-1,-1) q8),16,max(H,W)); fewer2=>16
input_geometry.box: Exact initial_query_box: finite non-(-1,-1) q8 minmax, lo=max(lo,0), hi=min(hi,[W-1,H-1]); fewer2 or anyspan<2 => null
input_geometry.helpers: Pure function AST only; no module imports/model loads

loss_admission_proposal.teacher_state: Independent GT label8:1VISIBLE/0COVERED/-1U; preserve original label even when query misses, training target separatelyU.
loss_admission_proposal.self: convex_self_proxy8_separate is visibility:1=may-visible,0=self-hidden,-1unknown; never self1=S and never merge into binary support target
loss_admission_proposal.admit: teacher known0/1 & query_center_valid & ROI_anyvalid & local_valid96.any & target_valid128.any & finite GTref & (-.5 <= (r-q)/L < .5).all
loss_admission_proposal.query_center_valid: finite/nonmissing & continuous native image bounds & floor(q+.5) nearest pixel bounds
loss_admission_proposal.ROI_anyvalid: Exact native_grid9 continuous sampled coordinate bounds; input-only
loss_admission_proposal.near_boundary: Retain already known teacher labels; no extra teacher quality filtering
loss_admission_proposal.query_miss: Reference outside unchanged half-open local square => trainingU/loss0, even if underlying teacherCOVERED; never relabel miss toCOVERED
loss_admission_proposal.unknown_and_invalid: U or invalid q/ref/input coverage => loss0; all rows retained
